CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to any identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations) is identified and presented alongside origin/representation metadata and explicit organization description; identity, organization and status are all present and bound to p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Report names contents ('red' and 'blue') with explicit location sets.

D.rationale: Content identities (color-location sets) are presented separately from origin/representation metadata, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates are organized (grid orientation) and provides origin/representation metadata indicating presentation/representation status.
